items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Sir Charles, Oscar Pettiford, Denzil Best, me and Hawk. And Hawk and I, at that time, we had gotten pretty tight together... except for... The only thing our difference was, was money.

ctx.x: melody that I knew. But I knew the changes, all the chord changes and all of that, which was a help regarding those -- I didn't know where I was at!
But all the cats used to come up there. Like, Prez used to come by there all the time. And ain't no tellin'... I loved Prez anyway. Wherever he was, I'd go find him, you know.
